content.appSecurity4: Code review requirements for all changes
content.appSecurity5: Bug bounty program for responsible disclosure

content.complianceDesc: We maintain compliance with industry standards and regulations:
content.reportVulnerabilityDesc: Found a security issue? Please report it responsibly to security@appnode.dev. We appreciate your help in keeping AppNode secure and offer rewards for valid reports.
content.dataProtectionDesc: We take data protection seriously. Your code, your projects, and your personal information are safeguarded with multiple layers of protection.
content.dataRight2: Export your projects at any time
content.dataRetentionDesc: We retain your data only as long as necessary to provide our services. When you delete your account, your data is permanently removed within 30 days.
content.generateCodeDesc: Learn different ways to generate code using AppNode's AI capabilities.
content.usingPromptBarDesc: The prompt bar is your primary interface for AI code generation. Type natural language descriptions to create components, pages, or entire features.
content.contextualGenerationDesc: Right-click any file or folder to generate code in context. AI understands your project structure and generates compatible code.
content.codeCompletionDesc: As you type, AI suggests completions based on your code context. Accept suggestions with Tab or continue typing to refine.
content.firstAppIntro: Follow this step-by-step guide to build your first application with AppNode.
content.firstAppStep1Text: Click "Create New" from your dashboard and choose "Create with AI" for the easiest start.
content.firstAppStep2Text: Try this prompt: "Create a simple todo list app with the ability to add, complete, and delete tasks. Use a clean, minimal design with a light theme."
content.firstAppStep3Text: AI will generate your app in real-time. You'll see files being created and a live preview updating as code is written.
content.firstAppStep4Text: Try asking: "Add a dark mode toggle" or "Make the completed tasks strikethrough" to see how AI can iterate on your app.
content.databasesIntro: Learn how to add persistent data storage to your AppNode applications.
content.databasesSqliteDesc: Simple, file-based database. Great for small apps.
content.databasesPostgresDesc: Full-featured relational database for complex data.
content.databasesRedisDesc: In-memory store for caching and sessions.
content.databasesAddingText: Simply describe your data needs: "I need to store users with name, email, and profile picture" and AI will set up the database schema and connections for you.
content.deployingIntro: Get your application live with one click. AppNode handles hosting, SSL, and scaling automatically.
content.deployingStep1Text: Hit the Deploy button in your workspace
content.deployingStep2Text: Use our free subdomain or connect your own
content.deployingStep3Text: Your app is deployed in seconds with SSL included
content.deployingCustomText: Connect your own domain by adding a CNAME record pointing to AppNode. SSL certificates are automatically provisioned.
content.teamsIntro: Collaborate with your team on AppNode. Share projects, manage permissions, and build together in real-time.
content.teamsSharedDesc: All team members can access and contribute to projects
content.teamsRoleDesc: Control who can view, edit, or deploy
content.teamsStep1: Create a team from your dashboard settings
content.enterpriseIntro: Advanced features for large organizations with complex requirements.
content.enterpriseSSODesc: Connect with your identity provider (Okta, Azure AD, etc.)
content.enterpriseAuditDesc: Track all actions across your organization
content.enterpriseSupportDesc: Priority support with dedicated account manager
content.enterpriseCloudDesc: Run AppNode in your own infrastructure
content.collaborationIntro: Work together seamlessly with real-time collaboration features.
content.collaborationItem1: See teammates' cursors in the editor
content.collaborationCommText: Use the built-in chat or connect your Slack workspace for seamless team communication.
